title: P112 rank-57 cover with scoped rational decoder cost floors
head: 18da668a4f248f5c0cf3fc94355068ead4db3476
body:
The original PR2041 cover has strict scalar fitting rank 99. This contribution changes the cover of the same 112 selected labels and certifies minimum scalar fitting rank **57**, with explicit factors and a matching identity minor. It then proves why minimizing scalar rank does not produce an affordable decoder under the full port-space tariff:

- **Exactly 57 rational rank-one terms cost at least 334**, over every fitting matrix on this mask. The saved construction attains 334, so this floor is sharp.
- **Every fit with at most 58 nonzero rational terms costs at least 297**, including asymmetric factors, exterior directions that cancel, and fitting matrices of rank 58. This lower bound is not claimed sharp.
- **The sharp minimum is 334 at any factor count** when the fitted matrix has rank 57 and both factor families remain in its column and row spaces. With `m=57+s` nonzero terms, `C >= 334+2s`. This supersedes the earlier valid but weaker 308 lower bound; adding terms inside both spans cannot improve the saved construction.

All three floors exceed the favorable positive-saving allowance `2672/9` (integer charge at most 296). A successful scalar decoder on this mask therefore needs **at least 59 terms**, and must also escape the rank-57/both-spans restriction. Those cases, changed covers and operator contracts remain open. **No cheaper decoder, native supplier, selected-result change or exponent improvement is claimed.**

The minimum-length proof uses the forced identity minor, Schur complement and duality. The sharp any-length/both-spans extension uses the same complete 40-space closure and 272 cheap rectangles. Retaining the identical pure-J count in the full57 and restricted54 acyclic bounds gives `C >=2m-3P+229` and `C >=2m+P+217`; their one-quarter/three-quarter convex combination is `C >=2m+220`. The new 58-term proof handles rank 57 through its one-sided exterior normal form, and rank 58 through a rank-one Schur complement whose support lies in a forest. Exact censuses cover **1,750 physical-triad spans, 2,318 affected-set unions and all 314 nonempty Schur support rectangles**. Singular paired maps, the exceptional 4/24 branch and a possible zero retained source column are handled explicitly. Rational coefficients are not reduced modulo two; binary linear algebra prices group geometry.

See the [sharp canonical-span proof](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18da668a4f248f5c0cf3fc94355068ead4db3476/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/CANONICAL-SHARP-PROOF.md), [rank-tight proof](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18da668a4f248f5c0cf3fc94355068ead4db3476/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/RANK-TIGHT-PROOF.md) and [exterior-factor proof](https://github.com/flyingviper/integer-mult-bounds/blob/18da668a4f248f5c0cf3fc94355068ead4db3476/research/p112-rational-decoder-gate/EXTERIOR-58-PROOF.md) for the written arguments. Validation on CPython 3.12.14, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rational-decoder-gate
```

All eight registered commands pass under `-I -O -B`. Separate implementations check the exact endpoints, whole-group tariffs, span closures and Schur census; semantic controls reject endpoint corruption, underpricing, incomplete closures and an added forest cycle. Three separate AI agents split constructive research and independent proof/checker review. These checks are not independent human review or proof-assistant verification. Bounded coordinate-motif searches found no cheaper construction and are not universal impossibility claims.

Task `coverage-law-change`, explicitly changed scope, retains its family budget and open questions in `TASK.json` and `README.md`. The construction's scientific source pins are unchanged. The sharp canonical-span refinement was checked against refreshed canonical main `28f54620ff770dd051d5df35882bd84303d13c6f`; guidance, selected record and consumed inputs were unchanged. The latest 100 updated open PR bodies were checked at 22:38 UTC on 2026-10-15. New PR2798 addresses a different fixed complex root-completion/COPY contract; PR2782 addresses positive half-integral Gram decoders, whereas this theorem permits arbitrary rational asymmetric factors in the stated full-group spans. Prior discussion access returned HTTP 406; cached discussions and fresh local notes were used without retrying the blocked route, so overlap coverage is bounded.

Credit is retained for Cinna Davis (#2041/#2126), Adam Gall (#1889), Sagar Thakrar (#2532 and different-mask rank certificate #2484), ywz65 (#2471), ctoth and collaborators, Philippe Van Velzen, Jeremy Diviney (#2203), icekylinx, woklerx, and the selected PR1094 source lineage. The general projection/excess-rank framework is prior work, including Hanson Sun's `decoder-excess-rank` package following joaqcoo/#1224; the new result is the cost consequence for this full-group mask. Exact distinctions and pins are in the package.

Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, proof, implementation and independent-agent checking. Apache-2.0.
